g.text: PM_WDI and HOST_WDI are heartbeat inputs.

g.desc: PM_WDI and HOST_WDI are heartbeat inputs.

g.text: AON_RESET_N and HOST_RESET_N report supply / manual reset.

g.desc: AON_RESET_N and HOST_RESET_N report supply / manual reset.

g.text: PM_WDO_N and HOST_WDO_N report watchdog expiry.

g.desc: PM_WDO_N and HOST_WDO_N report watchdog expiry.

g.text: J2501 and J2502 provide PM and host manual reset contacts.

g.desc: J2501 and J2502 provide PM and host manual reset contacts.

g.text: Supply undervoltage or manual reset asserts RESET.

g.desc: Supply undervoltage or manual reset asserts RESET.

g.text: PM expiry resets PM; host expiry also resets host via U5405.

g.desc: PM expiry resets PM; host expiry also resets host via U5405.

g.text: HOST_RESET_N pullups stay on SYS3V3; WDO pullups use AON.

g.desc: HOST_RESET_N pullups stay on SYS3V3; WDO pullups use AON.

g.text: Sheet 5400 adds application-heartbeat timeout and first-edge latch.

g.desc: Sheet 5400 adds application-heartbeat timeout and first-edge latch.

g.text: SET1 is high and CWD is open on both supervisors.

g.desc: SET1 is high and CWD is open on both supervisors.

g.text: Watchdog timeout: 1.60 s nominal, 1.36 to 1.84 s specified.

g.desc: Watchdog timeout: 1.60 s nominal, 1.36 to 1.84 s specified.

g.text: Provide falling WDI edges sooner than the minimum timeout.

g.desc: Provide falling WDI edges sooner than the minimum timeout.

g.text: Reset release delay and WDO low pulse are 200 ms nominal.

g.desc: Reset release delay and WDO low pulse are 200 ms nominal.

g.text: D2501 combines AON_RESET_N and PM_WDO_N into PM_RESET_N.

g.desc: D2501 combines AON_RESET_N and PM_WDO_N into PM_RESET_N.

g.text: Either LOW resets U2401 through the common-anode diode.

g.desc: Either LOW resets U2401 through the common-anode diode.

g.text: Host WDO now also pulls HOST_RESET_N LOW through U5405

g.desc: Host WDO now also pulls HOST_RESET_N LOW through U5405

g.text: on sheet 5400; both host faults clear matrix permission.

g.desc: on sheet 5400; both host faults clear matrix permission.

g.text: U2501 supervises the AON-powered MIRA power controller.

g.desc: U2501 supervises the AON-powered MIRA power controller.

g.text: U2502 supervises the SYS3V3 host domain and its heartbeat.

g.desc: U2502 supervises the SYS3V3 host domain and its heartbeat.

g.text: These independent monitors feed the permit interlocks so a

g.desc: These independent monitors feed the permit interlocks so a

g.text: stalled controller or host can inhibit operation without software.

g.desc: stalled controller or host can inhibit operation without software.

g.text: PM_WDI falling edges service the 1.60 s timer.

g.desc: PM_WDI falling edges service the 1.60 s timer.

g.text: AON reset or PM watchdog fault

g.desc: AON reset or PM watchdog fault

g.text: pulls the PM controller reset low.

g.desc: pulls the PM controller reset low.

g.text: Host reset coupling is on sheet 5400.

g.desc: Host reset coupling is on sheet 5400.

g.text: J2502 requests a host manual reset.

g.desc: J2502 requests a host manual reset.

g.text: R2509 pulls HOST_RESET_N to SYS3V3, not AON.

g.desc: R2509 pulls HOST_RESET_N to SYS3V3, not AON.
